reviews.text: Awesome replacement for the Fellow Ode Hopper - feed is so much better now!
I enjoy cardistry while I’m watching tv or just relaxing to keep my hands busy. So this makes it easy to grab my current go to decks. It even fits the tuck boxes with Carat DS1 sleeve protectors.
This is the second Fellow Ode Grinder Hopper Upgrade that we have purchased from this vendor.  We liked the first one, and decided to buy one as a gift for someone who has the same model grinder.
Fit my copy of Klask perfectly and works well. Love it.

ATTENTION: There are 2 sizes of Klask boards. The older ones have wider legs, about 12mm, versus the newer 9.5mm. If you see reviews complaining their feet don’t fit this is why. I have an older set and did not realize. I reached out and Chris was incredibly helpful and sent out a new set with a larger opening for my board.

If you don’t know how old your board is PLEASE measure first, and if it’s an old one just message and he will happily make you a fitting pair.
The bean hopper for the Fellow Ode is as described.  Installation was easy with the included hex tool and instructions.  The original lid fits perfectly.  No more stuck beans. ✅

This is an ingenious fix for the Ode v1's key failing - with this hopper, I no longer have to "chase" beans into the grinding mechanism.  I'm back to enjoying my Ode again.  I recommend this for anybody with a Gen 1 Ode.
excellent finish, perfect fit.

The new hopper looks great on my Ode 1. High quality material makes it feel like it belongs. I got the 60g hopper and it doesn’t interrupt the lines of the grinder in any noticeable way. If I had one small gripe it would be that it doesn’t incorporate the anti-popcorn plate from the original hopper, but overall I’d buy it again without hesitation.
